## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A five-fascicle Former-Qín partial translation of the *Aṣṭasāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā*, jointly produced by Dharmapriya 曇摩蜱 and Zhú Fóniàn 竺佛念 at Cháng'ān under [道安](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%89) Dàoān's direction. The title indicates the partial / *chāo* (鈔 "excerpted") status. Signature: 「秦天竺沙門曇摩蜱共竺佛念譯」. The Taishō head-note records the alternative title 「亦名長安品」 ("also named the Cháng'ān-section [text]").

**Abstract**

T226 is dated by the *Chū sānzàng jì jí* to *rénwǔ* 壬午 = 382 CE — the same year as [道安](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%89) Dàoān's other major Yèsì translation projects ([T1505](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0157)). The translation is a *chāo* (excerpt) of the *Aṣṭasāhasrikā*, possibly because the underlying Indic manuscript was incomplete. T226 is one of the four pre-Tang Chinese *Aṣṭasāhasrikā* translations and a key test-case for Dàoān-circle translation idiom.
